title: 第11章 主仆契约成第12章 灵魂奴役鼎炉成
slug: 人在废丹房我九阳圣体凭丹近神
content_zh:
;;
炼丹房内。
混乱的灵魂波动弥漫，如同是无形的滔滔浪花涌动，排挤虚空，发出阵阵闷响之声。
若是其他炼气修士在此，势必会被这灵魂波动击伤，乃至灵魂受创严重，变得痴傻。
不过，这种混乱的灵魂波动，随着兰月儿眉心当中有符箓灵光灵气浮现，很快就被驱散平息。
定魂符！
这一道九品中符箓。
她当初可是耗费了极大的代价才购买下来。
此符不仅可以庇护灵魂，还能辅助灵魂成长，有诸多妙用。
这也是她能够成为火工童子的缘故。
如今，更是因为这定魂符的存在，这才挡下了李安那恐怖的白虎精魄的冲击。
不然以李安刚刚展露出的白虎精魄的恐怖，她现在的灵魂境界，根本无法抵挡。
只怕是刹那之间，就会遭受重创。
甚至那灵魂烙印，还会折返落在自己身上。
这个李安，看着挺老实，没想到有这么多心眼子！
要不是自己另有底牌，今日便是自己给他做了嫁衣。
“你这才刚入门没多久，灵魂境界居然就能达到这种程度，还真是个小天才！”
兰月儿有些惊叹的打量着李安。
“不过，你的手段到此为止了！”
话落，兰月儿的神色就变得冰冷起来。

刚刚她有些马虎大意了。
不过李安也暴露出了他的算计和手段，白虎精魄已经被他用尽！
这一次，她不会再给李安任何机会！
当即，她眉心的《小魂决》母篇迅速运转起来，泥丸宫内的缥缈灵魂，立刻在眉心凝聚成一道呼啸的旋涡，牵引拉扯着李安的灵魂。
李安所修行的功法，被她的魂决所克制，他刚刚最强的攻势也被化解，如今不过是砧板上的鱼肉！
“《小魂决》母篇？在《灵魄决》面前，也敢放肆？”
见兰月儿直接催动了《小魂决》母篇，试图吞噬自己的灵魂，李安脸上顿时浮现出一片冰冷之色。
尽管兰月儿灵魂深处的符箓，打了他一个措手不及，不过，他修行的功法可是融合之后的八品上功法！
《小魂决》母篇，不过是九品功法，与八品功法之间，存在着巨大的鸿沟！
她如此自信地想要吞噬自己的灵魂，只能说已有将死之道！
于是，李安也是在此刻双手缔结手印，然后泥丸宫内的灵魂不闪不避，直接冲入到兰月儿的灵魂旋涡当中。
兰月儿刚开始还是心头一喜，毕竟李安的灵魂比她想象当中要精纯强大很多。
只要将他的灵魂吸收，自己十有八九就能成为真正的炼丹师！
从此成为人上人！
然而，随着越来越多的李安灵魂汇聚而来。
content_en:

In the alchemy room.
Chaotic soul fluctuations filled the air, like invisible waves surging, crowding out the void and making bursts of muffled sounds.
If other Qi Refining monks were here, they would definitely be injured by this soul wave, and even their souls would be seriously injured and become stupid.
However, this chaotic soul fluctuation was quickly dispelled and calmed down as the talisman's aura emerged between Lan Yue'er's eyebrows.
Soul fixing talisman!
This is a ninth-grade middle talisman.
She had spent a huge price to buy it.
This talisman can not only protect the soul, but also assist the soul's growth and has many wonderful uses.
This is also the reason why she can become a pyrotechnic boy.
Now, it is even more because of the existence of this soul-fixing talisman that it has blocked the impact of Li An's terrifying white tiger essence.
Otherwise, with the horror of the white tiger spirit that Li An had just revealed, her current soul state would be impossible to resist.
I am afraid that in just an instant, he will suffer heavy losses.
Even the soul mark will come back to fall on himself.
This Li An looks quite honest, but I didn't expect him to be so thoughtful!
If I hadn't had another trump card, I would have made him a wedding dress today.
"You have only just started, but your soul realm has reached this level. You are really a little genius!"
Lan Yue'er looked at Li An in amazement.
"However, your methods stop here!"
As soon as she finished speaking, Lan Yue'er's expression turned cold.
She was a little careless just now.
However, Li An also exposed his calculations and methods, and the white tiger's essence has been exhausted by him!
This time, she won't give Li An any chance!
Immediately, the main chapter of "Little Soul Jue" in the center of her eyebrows quickly started to operate, and the ethereal souls in Niwan Palace immediately condensed into a whistling vortex in the center of her eyebrows, pulling and pulling Li An's soul.
The skills that Li An practiced were restrained by her soul skills, and his strongest attack just now was also neutralized. Now he is just fish on the chopping board!
"The mother chapter of "Little Soul Art"? Do you dare to be presumptuous in front of "Lingso Art"?"
Seeing that Lan Yue'er directly activated the main chapter of "Little Soul Art" and tried to devour his own soul, a cold look suddenly appeared on Li An's face.
Although the talisman deep in Lan Yue'er's soul caught him off guard, the skills he practiced were the eighth-level skills after fusion!
The main chapter of "Little Soul Jue" is just a ninth-level skill, and there is a huge gap between the eighth-level skill!
She so confidently wants to devour her own soul that she can only say that she has a way to die!
Therefore, Li An also concluded the mudra with his hands at this moment, and then the soul in Niwan Palace rushed directly into Lan Yue'er's soul vortex without dodge.
Lan Yue'er was happy at first. After all, Li An's soul was much more pure and powerful than she imagined.
As long as he absorbs his soul, he will most likely become a real alchemist!
Become a master from now on!
However, as more and more Ang Lee's souls gathered.
